title: Specified external Cech cup on pure factor homology generators
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme] with affine diagonals, and let $F,G$ be quasi-coherent modules on $X,Y$ [pqf-def-coherent]. Let $U,V$ be finite affine open covers of $X,Y$. Write $T,P$ for the tensor and product Cech functors [def-sc-picard-external-right-cech-models]. Suppose $\theta:T\Rightarrow P$ satisfies the front/back cochain-coordinate predicate of [lem-sc-picard-right-cech-cup-construction]. Write $A,B,C$ for the fixed scalar models of $F,G$ and their external coefficient [lem-sc-picard-kunneth-resolution-model]. For each $n\in\mathbb N$, put $I_n=\{(p,q)\in\mathbb N^2:p+q=n\}$. There are a $k$-linear equivalence $e:\bigoplus_{(p,q)\in I_n}H^p(A)\otimes_kH^q(B)\cong H^n(T(G))$ and an isomorphism $b:H^n(P(G))\cong H^n(C)$. For every $(p,q)\in I_n$ and factor homology classes $x,y$, applying $e$ to the summand inclusion of $x\otimes y$, then $H^n(\theta_G)$, then $b$, and then the fixed scalar-model comparison gives $\operatorname{externalCup}(\epsilon_A(x),\epsilon_B(y))$ [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations], with degree transported along $p+q=n$. The comparisons and generator formula are asserted together. No scalar-total cycle or comparison from scalar-total homology occurs in this statement.

proof.text: Obtain canonical factor comparisons alpha,beta and product comparison b with the signed formula on natural Cech tensor cocycles.

Apply natural-indexed tensor Kunneth to the factor Cech complexes. Precompose with the direct sum of tensors of alpha inverse and beta inverse and postcompose with inverse extension homology. Precompose the resulting equivalence with the direct sum of scalar automorphisms (-1)^(p*q) of each (p,q) tensor summand. Each scalar is a unit over every field, including characteristic two; the construction uses actual LinearEquiv.smulOfUnit and DirectSum.congrLinearEquiv data.

Lift the inverse factor-comparison images of x,y to cycles. The Kunneth formula supplies their total cycle. On its direct-sum generator the new automorphism is multiplication by (-1)^(p*q). Move this integer scalar through all linear comparisons and use the signed geometric cycle formula. Alpha and beta cancel their inverses, proving the unchanged unsigned conclusion. The sign equals one in degree zero and acts harmlessly on zero factors or empty schemes.

theorem picardRightCechCup_generators
    {k : Type w} [Field k] {X Y : Scheme.{w}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal f)] [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal g)]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    {ι κ : Type w} [Finite ι] [Finite κ]
    (U : ι → X.Opens) (V : κ → Y.Opens)
    (hU : ∀ i, IsAffineOpen (U i)) (hV : ∀ j, IsAffineOpen (V j))
    (hUc : iSup U = ⊤) (hVc : iSup V = ⊤)
    (θ : picardRightTensorCechFunctor f g U V F ⟶
      picardRightProductCechFunctor f g U V F)
    (hθ : IsPicardRightCechCup f g U V F θ)
    (G : Y.Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent] (n : ℕ) :
        ∃ (e : (⨁ i : {pq : ℕ × ℕ // pq.1 + pq.2 = n},
              (picardScalarModel f F).homology (i.val.1 : ℤ) ⊗[k]
                (picardScalarModel g G).homology (i.val.2 : ℤ)) ≃ₗ[k]
              ((picardRightTensorCechFunctor f g U V F).obj G).homology (n : ℤ))
          (b : ((picardRightProductCechFunctor f g U V F).obj G).homology (n : ℤ) ≅
            (picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
              (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)).homology (n : ℤ)),
          ∀ (i : {pq : ℕ × ℕ // pq.1 + pq.2 = n})
            (x : (picardScalarModel f F).homology (i.val.1 : ℤ))
            (y : (picardScalarModel g G).homology (i.val.2 : ℤ)),
            picardScalarModelEquiv (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
                (externalCupCoefficients f g F G) n
              (b.hom (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (θ.app G) (n : ℤ)
                (e (DirectSum.lof k _ _ i (x ⊗ₜ[k] y))))) =
              cast (congrArg (fun d ↦ ↥(scalarCohomology (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
                (externalCupCoefficients f g F G) d)) i.property)
                (externalCup f g F G i.val.1 i.val.2
                  (picardScalarModelEquiv f F i.val.1 x)
                  (picardScalarModelEquiv g G i.val.2 y))
